name: finnexus-ecosystem
description: FinNexus Unified Enterprise Platform - Monorepo with 4 Independent Frontend Applications and Shared FastAPI Backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "DASH,CRM,TOOL,INS" -c "blue,emerald,teal,cyan" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:crm" "npm run dev:toolkit" "npm run dev:insurance"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=dashboard && npm run build --workspace=crm && npm run build --workspace=toolkit && npm run build --workspace=insurance-engine
